newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close up, led by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close up, led by blue chips.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed up on Wednesday, led by activity among highly capitalised blue chips, brokers said.
The all share index closed 6.8 points up at 805.3. Blue chips Commercial Bank rose five rupees to 225, John Keells Holdings 14.75 to 325.
"The all share should rise to about 830 points on good growth expected for the period to June 30, before the next bout of profit-taking," said Aslem Ahmed of CDIC Sasoon Cumberbatch.
Turnover was 98.5 million rupees, led by trading of 131,000 shares of the blue chip Development Finance.

"Turnover has been healthy despite Hong Kong being on holiday, because there is a fair amount of depth in the local market and significant buying from London and the U.S.," said Sarinda Unbamboowe of brokerage John Keells.
Investors believe that the all share should rise faster when Hong Kong reopens on Thursday, brokers said.
